annotation.title_clean: Lebanon's Digital and AI Transformation: A Strategic Roadmap by the Minister of State for Technology and AI
annotation.title_en: Lebanon's Digital and AI Transformation: A Strategic Roadmap by the Minister of State for Technology and AI
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Office of the Minister of State for Information Technology and AI (MITAI), Lebanon
annotation.summary_en: Lebanon's MITAI presents its five-year LEAP strategy for digital and AI transformation, covering institutional restructuring, digital infrastructure, talent, investment and an AI-first government by 2030. It is innovation-focused, with brief mention of data protection and cybersecurity law. It contains no robotics or embodied-AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establish Ministry of Technology and AI (MITAI) pending parliamentary approval of its law
New institutional structure by end-2026: digital authority, cybersecurity institute, TDRA as data/telecom regulator
LEAP strategy: Launch, Enact, Advance, Promote over 100 days to 5 years
2030 targets: 80% services digitized, US$500M AI investment, 10,000+ AI engineers per year
Priorities include data protection, privacy and cybersecurity laws and responsible-use guidelines
